notes.title: Interview moves to next week
notes.text: You told me your original degree certificate and transcript only reach you next week, so the Friday slot cannot happen. I have dated this Friday 16 October as a placeholder - change it when Fitria gives you the new slot. - Tell her now rather than no-showing, or rebooking gets harder.

notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at TLS Contact
notes.title: Passport clash with your KITAS
notes.text: The consulate keeps your passport from submission until the decision, roughly two to three weeks, and you also need it for the KITAS exit permit and your 7 November flight. Submitting in Jakarta after a mid-October interview leaves no margin. - Applying from India in November is the safer route.
